full_judgment:
7. Mr M Fazlul Karim the learned Advocate for the accused appellant has taken us through the evidence on record and the judgment delivered by the trial Court and has argued that there is absolutely no evidence on record to show that the accused appellant Noor Mohammed assaulted the deceased in any manner as a result of which she died, that none of the witnesses saw the accused appellant Noor Mohammad assaulting the deceased or removing the dead body of the deceased to the bamboo clump and tying her neck by a start to any bamboo, that PW 8 Abu Saleh, full brother of deceased Lutfunnessa stated in his cross-examination that in the house of occurrence on 6-9-83 Abdul Motaleb and others told him that accused appellant's brother Yusuf had caused the death of his sister Lutfunnessa, that adverse presumption against she prosecution should be drawn for non-examination of Mr. Md. Atiqul Islam Chowdhury, Thana Nirbahi Officer who recorded the statement of accused Md. Hossain under section 164 CrPC that there is no evidence to show that the death of deceased Lutfunnessa occurred in the house of accused appellant Noor Mohammad and that the order of conviction and sentence passed by the trial Court should be set-aside as it is based on mere conjectures and surmises. 

 "When according to defence dao blow was dealt by wife on the person of husband, then it goes by reasonable presumption that husband was likely to follow the wife to take revenge of the dao blow dealt on him and therefore, it goes by logical presumption that husband caused the injury to the wife who died as a result and there after attempt was made by the husband to change the incident into case of suicide."
